## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON with Growth/Momentum tilt. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector breadth (≥7/11) and simultaneous strength in Financials/Cyclicals plus Technology participation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.28% | 1M: +3.46%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: D (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate firm: AMT (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: DOW (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -7.47%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -3.15%) BELOW TREND. Industrials soft: DE (1W: -7.53% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -6.52% | 1M: -7.56%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples at risk: WMT (1W: -8.39% | 1M: -6.47%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: IBM (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +10.15% | 1M: -3.28%) RECOVERY; ACN (1W: +8.46% | 1M: -6.43%) RECOVERY; D (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND; AMT (1W: +7.79% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: Growth/Momentum.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CAT (1W: -5.90% | 1M: +7.06%) CORRECTION; NEE (1W: -6.26% | 1M: -0.34%) BELOW TREND; DD (1W: -6.45% | 1M: +2.95%) CORRECTION; ETN (1W: -6.52% | 1M: -7.56%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -18.83% | 1M: -24.86%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials/Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: IBM (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.15% | 1M: -3.28%) RECOVERY, ACN (1W: +8.46% | 1M: -6.43%) RECOVERY, D (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +56.84%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present: multiple mega-caps (NVDA, GOOGL, TSLA etc.) show 1W vs 1M mismatch — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive: AAPL (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +11.75%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.58% | 1M: -2.98%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -3.34% | 1M: +14.25%) CORRECTION, QCOM (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +56.84%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: 15/24 positive (Internal Rotation).

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive with select leaders: JPM (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -3.20%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +6.59%) ABOVE TREND, MET (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +10.36%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: 12/20 positive (Internal Rotation).

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Generally steady with pockets of strength: LLY (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.24%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +2.49%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -4.16% | 1M: +8.19%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: +0.78% | 1M: -1.57%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: 10/17 positive (Internal Rotation).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Financials and selective Technology names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND (e.g., QCOM, IBM, V). Reduce exposure to cyclical Industrials and Materials exhibiting BELOW TREND (DE, DOW, ETN). Monitor NVDA/GOOGL/TSLA CORRECTIONs as tactical opportunities if confirmation appears.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: LLY (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.24%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +56.84%) ABOVE TREND; D (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTU (1W: -18.83% | 1M: -24.86%) BELOW TREND; META (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -9.98%) BELOW TREND; NEM (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -3.15%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (15/24 positive) and Financials (12/20 positive) for continued leadership. BEARISH: Materials (3/11 positive) and Industrials (4/15 positive) for downside risk.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION — reclaiming the prior weekly swing high would signal trend resumption. AAPL (1W: +2.27% | 1M: +11.75%) ABOVE TREND — a pullback toward the 50-day would offer a re-test for continuation. JPM (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -3.20%) RECOVERY — sustained move above recent resistance would confirm rotation into Financials.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
D (+85): One Thing Investors Should Know About NextEra's Acquisition of Dominion — D (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. DE (+75): Deere hikes outlook — DE (1W: -7.53% | 1M: -8.39%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price (watch for follow-through). LLY (+55): Obesity drug data — LLY (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.24%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming strength. NVDA (+55): CFO comments on CPU revenue — NVDA (1W: -6.88% | 1M: +8.40%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines diverging from short-term price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UPS (-80): Safety inspection flaw headline — UPS (1W: n/a | 1M: n/a) at risk given headline (monitor operational updates). META (-50): Texas suit on encryption privacy — META (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -9.98%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. INTU (-50): Tax-software sales miss headline — INTU (1W: -18.83% | 1M: -24.86%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and pressure remains. NEM (-55): Cost concerns headline — NEM (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -3.15%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Growth/Momentum tilt; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive and leadership is broad across Tech, Financials and select Utilities. QCOM (1W: +6.66% | 1M: +56.84%) ABOVE TREND and IBM (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +1.18%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major-cap divergences (NVDA, GOOGL, TSLA CORRECTIONs) and mixed headlines (DE/INTU) warrant tactical caution and close monitoring.
